fileHeader.description: Three-axis motion control, CSP architecture (Cyclic Synchronous Position). Layer 1: INTERP FB (interpolation engine) — trapezoidal trajectory planner in the PLC, outputs one position setpoint per scan, per-command dynamics (vel/acc/dec) and abort semantics. Layer 2: DRIVE402 FB (drive model) — receives cyclic position setpoints, closes position loop (P + setpoint-rate feedforward), CiA 402 state machine, velocity output to motor. Layer 3: PLCopen Motion Control aligned MC API — MC_Power/MC_Reset/MC_Stop/MC_Halt/MC_MoveAbsolute/MC_MoveRelative/MC_MoveJog/MC_Home plus MC_ReadStatus/MC_ReadActualPosition; standard status outputs (Done/Busy/Active/CommandAborted/Error/ErrorID). PLC only plans and streams setpoints; the drive does the loops.
